messages:
Nora (CS): Glyph hit higher tail latency and some stream stalls after a feature flip. Renewal next week; they asked for a short runbook they can paste into their ops channel. Can we make a 1-page checklist focused on caching, batching, streaming, and quick troubleshooting?
Lee (Eng): Yep. Keep bullets and one-line impact. Draft: 
- Add priming header: X-Client-Priming: true -> routes to warm pools; reduces cold tail.
- Tenant hot-prefix cache: TTL=20s, scope=tenant -> repeated prompt p95 down.
- Client bundling: max 6 requests / 30ms wait -> lowers QPS and overhead. Snippet: client.batchSend({maxBatch:6,maxWaitMs:30})
- Stream chunk tuning: chunk_tokens=64 -> prevents head-of-line stalls. Toggle: X-Disable-Streaming: true.
- Fallback model header: X-Model-Fallback: compact-1 -> keeps availability under capacity pressure.
Priya (Onboarding): Add telemetry checks: warm-pool hit %, prefill latency, per-route p99, bundle success rate. Also a 3-question feedback template for post-change calls.
Lee (Eng): Troubleshooting quick fixes: 
- If tail spikes after deploy: verify cache warm-up, bump TTL to 30s, enable async prefill.
- If origin errors surge: add token-bucket throttle on prefill fetches; reduce bundle size.
ops-bot: Created doc "glyph-runbook-v1" at /shared/cs-assets.
Nora (CS): Action items: @Priya convert to one-pager (EOD), @Lee add safe defaults and add a tiny JSON snippet of defaults. I'll schedule a 20-min review with Glyph.
Priya (Onboarding): Will post draft link here when ready.
note: Single-thread Slack transcript for a customer-facing runbook checklist.
